ADDED i1: Tests {@link FileTimes#toUnixTime(FileTime)} in combination with {@link FileTimes#isUnixTime(long)}.

Standard Unix time is stored as a signed 32-bit number

ADDED i2: Provides instants paired with the expected {@code isUnixTime} result for their Unix-second value.

The boundary instants correspond to {@link Integer#MAX_VAL
ADDED i4: In range: the maximum representable Unix second (Integer.MAX_VALUE).
ADDED i5: In range: near the lower boundary.
ADDED i6: Out of range: below Integer.MIN_VALUE seconds.
ADDED i7: Out of range: one second past the maximum representable Unix second.
ADDED i8: Out of range: far in the future, beyond Integer.MAX_VALUE seconds.
